name: contaduria-municipal
description: Sistema de Contaduría Municipal de Trancas

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @contaduria/backend" "npm run dev -w @contaduria/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @contaduria/backend && npm run build -w @contaduria/frontend && node infra/scripts/write-version.mjs
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d && node infra/scripts/wait-db.mjs && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
